reviews.title: Not worth it even with the Toyota package
reviews.text:
I purchased OBD Fusion plus the full Toyota enhanced diagnostics package because I have a 2014 Prius and a 2004 Land Cruiser. Despite that, the app is disappointing.
Reading codes and data is slow. Clearing codes is buried deep in the menus and there is no easy way to clear individual codes. The app also fails to read the VIN, so everything has to be entered manually in the Vehicle Editor. Even with the paid Toyota package, the basic diagnostic workflow feels clumsy and overcomplicated compared with simpler tools.
The live-data and customization features exist, but they do not make up for the sluggish, buried everyday functions. Expensive and not pleasant to use. Would not buy again.

reviews.title: Could Be Great
reviews.text: This app could be great if it had a modern UI, allowed for more customization, and reliably connected with the OBD reader. The UI is very outdated, everything is gray and boring, the gauges are not appealing, and things are hard to find in the UI. There is some customization but not enough. I want to be able to show whole numbers on readouts, I don’t need MPG to the hundredth of a mile. I would also like nice gauges in CarPlay not just rows of numbers. Lastly, the connection reliability is what bothers me the most about this app. It will work fine one day and then the next day it won’t connect no matter what I try. Then it works fine the next day. It makes absolutely no sense and it drives me insane. I don’t know if I would recommend this app to anyone unless it receives a heavy refresh and debugging.

reviews.title: Missing promised features
reviews.text: The app looks nice but has some problems. First, the dev seems biased to other makes since only a few manufacturer PID’s are available with initial purchase. I can’t get a simple PID for oil pressure out of this app when I get it from free ones. I bought the add-on PID for my car’s make and it still doesn’t show up. That’s $20 I’ve spent so far! 😤🤬

reviews.title: Works well but…
reviews.text: Once you get it to connect everything works fine, but sometimes getting it to connect to your phone is problematic. I do not know if it is a problem with the unit or just the app. Either way it is annoying.

reviews.title: No Dashboard CarPlay integration
reviews.text: The app haves a lot of configuration tools and great dashboards, however it is not worth the purchase as the Apple CarPlay integration is terrible. You cannot monitor the information setup in dashboards with Apple CarPlay and that makes this a 2 star purchase. If the app had dashboard display for CarPlay, it would be well worth the $10 purchase price.

reviews.title: Not for iPhone
reviews.text: Works great on android but very fussy on iPhone so it’s unusable to me. Wasted my $

reviews.title: False description
reviews.text: Paid 10 dollars for this app as it said it would read abs codes. Get into the app and it has no option to read abs code for bmw. Baited in by a false app description and wasted 10 dollars!

reviews.title: Mazda Extended Support is terrible
reviews.text: They don’t tell you what extended PIDs are supported until after you pay $15 for the license. I paid to get information to diagnose my AC issues on a 2019 3, and none of the relevant PIDs are even available through this app. No option for a refund.

reviews.title: Easy and cheap used with caution
reviews.text:
Been using this for a few years on and off for simple things like misfires.
There is a long lag in slow rate on misfires and O2 sensors had me chasing a misfire in cylinder 1 in fact, it was cylinder 2 on the opposite side of a V8 engine
Makes it tough to diagnose when the tool points you in the wrong direction

reviews.title: Not what you think
reviews.text: It’s the identical ap as the one OBDmx link is except it has the add on ability to list certain read parameters on your CarPlay screen,  it’s a list only and minimal options.  Glad I only wasted $10 otherwise I’d be more upset.  Don’t buy it wait until someone makes a better app not modify one that’s already made.
